title: Team Assemblers
description: Work as part of a team having responsibility for assembling an entire product or component of a product. Team assemblers can perform all tasks conducted by the team in the assembly process and rotate through all or most of them, rather than being assigned to a specific task on a permanent basis. May participate in making management decisions affecting the work. Includes team leaders who work as part of the team.

tasks.text: Perform quality checks on products and parts.
tasks.rationale: visual inspection — Material quality often needs hands-on or visual inspection

dwas.name: Evaluate quality of materials or products.
dwas.gwa_name: Judging the Qualities of Objects, Services, or People

tasks.text: Review work orders and blueprints to ensure work is performed according to specifications.
tasks.rationale: information retrieval — Parse specs and materials from orders

dwas.name: Read work orders or other instructions to determine product specifications or materials requirements.

tasks.text: Rotate through all the tasks required in a particular production process.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physical assembly of products by hand
decision support — Sequence planning aided; production constraints human-verified

dwas.name: Plan production or operational procedures or sequences.

tasks.text: Supervise assemblers and train employees on job procedures.
tasks.rationale: interpersonal — Equipment instruction requires live demonstration and correction

dwas.name: Instruct workers to use equipment or perform technical procedures.

tasks.text: Shovel, sweep, or otherwise clean work areas.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Hands-on cleaning of work areas

tasks.text: Provide assistance in the production of wiring assemblies.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Fine dexterity assembling electronics
physical manipulation — Physical production equipment maintenance

tasks.text: Complete production reports to communicate team production level to management.
tasks.rationale: data analysis — Record production data into structured logs

tasks.text: Package finished products and prepare them for shipment.
tasks.rationale: physical manipulation — Physically packaging products for shipment

dwas.name: Package products for storage or shipment.

tasks.text: Operate machinery and heavy equipment, such as forklifts.
tasks.rationale: situated mobility — Driving forklifts requires real-world navigation and control
